contentList.content: This cannot be allowed to happen. One final act of resistance - kill yourself.
What was that? Are my senses betraying me...?
You bear your burdens with grace.
Are you calling me chubby? Brains are leaner than many food sources, I'll have you know...
Tut tut. This maggot should end himself.
It was simply a misunderstanding.
Death
*You and Gale have made a home for yourselves in Waterdeep. Sometimes it isn't clear what he loves more - his research, or you.*
Well now I miss home. Shall we skip the festivities and head back?
We still have each other. That's all I'll ever need.
Paper Bubble C
Vengeful husks - just shadows of shadows without Bhaal's rage to fill them.
Read
Comic Effect C
You've never been far from my mind. You're braver than all of Vlaakith's forces combined.
I tumbled away, cast Flesh to Stone, and it crashed to the ground. I could have ended the battle there and then. But this was prey that deserved to be played with.
Asking: Ready
You could have been a god, but I suppose 'wizard' will do.
It would not go amiss, if you are willing.
Rapier +1
I found a little cottage; abandoned, half-ruined - there's a lot of such places to be found, thanks to the Absolute's armies. I've been making it my own.
True enough. I still hunt devils, protect the coast - but now, I do it on my terms.
I take joy in peaceful routine - tea ceremonies, that kind of thing.
They may be curious to hear how your parents are doing, after all it took to free them.
I've had to walk a delicate path, killing devils while keeping Mizora on my side.
Turns out, Old Gnawbone had kids. And one of them flew the roost and took to stalking a small elven enclave outside Kryptgarden Forest.
Oh, I didn't mean - well, I didn't mean that. I'd just gutted the ogre, not...
Paralysing Ray
Fighting at Lae'zel's side. Vlaakith is clinging to power, but the tide is turning in our favour, battle by battle.
*And you were doing so well. No matter - another will serve in your stead. As for you...?
We can't take opportunities like this for granted. Let's enjoy ourselves while everyone's paths have aligned.
You're being modest, I see how you've rallied this city behind you - what you've done to restore its glory.
Gale wanted more, and you encouraged him to ignore every sensible instinct, to ignore the lesson of Karsus' Folly, and to reach for the heavens.
Loading Mod
Now, divine as my company undoubtedly is, I've an eternity to catch up with you - a luxury few others at this party possess.
*You have defiled the creature's land. You must be disciplined.*
Such a ward ought to empower whoever stands astride it. Let us find out.
My new form has dictated that I live a discreet existence, yet not one without ambition. The Emperor and I are close collaborators.
Of course.
Duke Wyll Ravengard. Zhak vo'n'fynh duj.
Do you wish it?
I have lived many lives. It is only right you be allowed to live another. Take this.
Away, my friend! Minsc shall soon strip, and Boo would not see you blinded.
Mizora wouldn't dare risk it as long as I'm more valuable as a warlock.
Regret it? I don't know. I wish there had been another way.

My friend, my confidante, my rescuer:

None of us lives a life without regret, and mine is no exception. I thought I'd lost my son to a devil - but it was my own hubris that drove him away. And then, a miracle: you brought him back to me. And for that, you have my eternal thanks.

It's with a heavy heart, then, that I bid you farewell. Wyll has chosen a new path, and I mean to follow. What our futures hold, I can't say - the Absolute's parasites are still lodged in our heads, after all. But I will approach my destiny with my only son at my side.

Regards,

Ulder Ravengard, Grand Duke of Baldur's Gate
Fuck Baldur's Gate. Fuck Avernus. They're mine now.
Perhaps not, but now I'm wondering if any of this meant anything.
*Your darling would never agree to breed a spawn with you... The defiance begets death.*
Now, thou speakest like me. Thou hast wisdom, after all.
Boulder
Yes, the right person can make just about anything bearable. And it seems like you found exactly the right person.
I have a little boudoir just below a new drow restaurant in the Lower City. It's very fungal - you'd like it.
I suppose we do. But I certainly wish we didn't.
A host of matters. It would be unwise to speak too freely... even among friends.
*Hunters, killers, tormentors. But you need not fear - this letter is an invitation, and it comes from a friend.*
Don't worry, you'll start enjoying yourself in no time.
How could I say no?
What haven't I done? Delved into dungeons, read secret tomes, taken out a rogue shadow mage or two. Enough magic and mystery for a treasury of tales.
I've been enjoying my innate and effortless talent for magic, of course. No further education required.
As I recall, you had a very... active imagination, shall we say.
Ultra Performance
For that is the day we can finally be together.
I am Wyll Ravengard, Grand Duke of the Wyrm, Heart of the Gate.
For sleep will ever find thee, but thou may not see thy friends again until the end of days.
Vlaakith's hunger has known the heads of fifty thousand of her subjects.
Do you think Shar will notice if I steal a kiss from you, for old time's sake?
Hubris
Fear of rejection, fear of failure, fear of not living up to the impossible expectations of a mad queen.
Letter from Halsin
You must be wondering what I've been doing this past while.
So, the gnomes know Gond as Nebelun. The little pests probably think all those extra syllables make them sound intelligent.
I've been learning to see the world anew, without the tunnel vision my oath imposed. It's been... enlightening.
You've got it all wrong. I am in it for the glory.
You're going to get yourself killed - you can't fight everyone you disagree with.
Exactly what I feared. Without the protection of our little friends I was just an ordinary spawn again, burning in the sun. I fled the dock and found refuge in the shadows until night fell.
Boulder
In ample time indeed! So long as the bone-mage returns us to our cell by dawn. Boo would not be late to the bloodshed.
Tombstone
To brains without worms and a good night's sleep!
Have you gone after Mizora? I'm sure you're eager for payback.
Jannath House to Host Evening of Art and Culture, Celebrating Salvation of City
I've heard my followers express the same desire. They'll do their best to stop you...
I've missed you, Karlach. When Vlaakith has fallen, I will return to you.
And I've been telling them about you of course - how brave and selfless you were, going to the Hells with Karlach. And a lot more besides; you're my favourite topic.
Spoilsport.
You've done everything you can. I want for nothing.
Thou might endure a great aeon of mourning. But thou must hope, as once she did.
*Zaerith Menyar-Ag-Gith - you've heard the name. The immortal god-king of the githzerai, and ruler of their capital, Shra'kt'lor.*
I'm assuming your life has been anything but dull?
Wayward Undead
I sense her presence, yes - and Shar's dismay. Her minions have tried to claim my head several times. Tried and failed.
Claws to the fore, Boo! Something makes Minsc's hair stand on end...
*The world is yours for the taking. A world you have made your own.*
Avernus is... interesting. We've been making a mess down there, that's for sure...
Can't fault you for being clear about limits. It can be just the two of us.
Alas, I have had to get my hands dirty.
I did not escape Bhaal's influence to become a monster of my own free will.
*Hiss!*
Paper Bubble Tail A
I confess, I wasn't entirely sure what to wear. Usually our meetings are a little more, er, clandestine, shall we say...
Sounds wonderful.
I am surprised you aren't among my followers. I am the God of Ambition, after all.
Gale decided not to return to his home of Waterdeep, deciding to forge a path somewhere new.
Githyanki Knights Helped Save the City?
Wait! I - I yield! I yield!
I'm just glad of a night off from the ever-present threat of danger and death.
Letter from Valeria
So long as you're aware that all domains shall be consumed by Lady Shar, in the end. Until then, enjoy it.
Not on your life. I'd rather leave the politics to you.
It doesn't do to keep a wizard waiting, especially one of Elminster's reputation. Not to mention appetite.
Curious. To hear you describe the life of an illithid, it almost sounds like a form of godhood...
Blood Splatter A
Even mind flayers appreciate a good tune - it's an honour to meet the Lord of Song.
I still have a lot to learn, but my father has been a helpful guide.
Pluck Soul
Even if you're an arse, it's still an honour to hear the Lord of Song play.
Glance around - is there anything else you could eat?
By the Nine Hells, think of the stories we could tell.
Illusion Wizard
Hells - I've never felt magic so powerful. Focus your strikes!
From the look of those letters, one might guess you've been eating carrier pigeons.
Only a joke. Bhaal-me would have been salivating by now.
He'll behave. He knows who his friends are.
Why not? I think I can tear myself away from the temple for a bit.
You're just trying to be hurtful, now.
Shar inflicted such misery on you. Most would find it unbearable, but you have shown resilience.
Get over it, cat. The wizard's mine.
Ta-ta, darling.
2nd Place Trophy
Only so many criminals stalk the Undercity. I need more food, Wyll.
An odd, but meticulous organisational system orders these ancient tomes.
Seems they snared more than they could skin in you. Did Geraldus survive?
Souls Sacrificed: 1
I spent too long defined by what other people did to me. The choices other people made for me - but that's over now.
I've been trying to relax - lots of herbal tea and breathing exercises.
... young Rylen cast Enlarge on it by mistake. The beast rampaged through the baths, demolished Oghma's temple, and smashed through the east wall.
It was a hell of a journey, but at least we've ended it together.
A tale of battle told by Blade of Frontiers? I'm eager to hear!
Perhaps I missed you, despite myself.
I tried to use the Crown of Karsus without learning enough about it first. It didn't go well.
Then better you do not know.
*An invitation to a gathering of the friends and allies who stood by your side in the fight against the Absolute.*
Wyll Ravengard, the Blade of Frontiers. Devil-horned, and angel-hearted!
I was beginning to think you'd forgotten about me. About your promise...
I will remember you said that.
There's no end in sight to my travels, for now.
*The gathering will not be in the city that you saved though. It will be where your adventures together began.*
Perhaps that is so. It has been so long that I may have forgotten the peril that I faced.
Mizora's scent is as hard to wash off as her influence.
Do you regret turning from Orpheus' cause and joining Karlach in the Hells?
Someone of your prowess should really be following the God of Ambition, if I can be so bold as to suggest it.
Pity I didn't crack a few jokes around the campfire then.
Tyrant's Edict
These days it's rather effortless. Godhood does wonders for one's sense of style...
Champion of Mahkloompah
What? Like you wouldn't have jumped at the chance.
Settling back into Waterdeep, catching up on my reading. I've even indulged in a spot of teaching...
If only you could join me. The trolls I've torn open, the ghouls I've cleaved - the stories I've been itching to tell.
I take joy in peaceful routine - I've gotten good at draconic tea ceremonies.
Water under the bridge, as far as I'm concerned. Looking forward to working with you, Wyll.
Still smashing skulls and raging at my enemies. It's bloody brilliant.
My life is in constant peril. Every day on this world could be my last.
'Teaching' you was hardly an effort at all. Not like my present cohort of apprentices.
Giving
I'd like to hear how you ended up fighting in the Blood War.
Yisk Gith'ka tavki krash'ht.
But you won't. I know you won't. You've followed Karsus straight down the road to ruin. And I won't be there to watch, Gale.
I'm your willing accomplice in all things - what do you think is worth telling?
A whirlwind visit from Avernus is no mean feat. It's a wonder how Withers managed to bring us here.
You will have seen my thoughts are disciplined. I make a valuable ally.
Have you come to torment me with hypotheticals, old friend?
You're working with him?
Flying 01
Somewhat, but I'm itching to get back.
*He looks coyly at the ground, suddenly shy.*
Soon to be very unhappy, for he has slipped Boo's leash once more. Perhaps he was too shy to meet you.
That's everything. Goodbye, not-quite-Gale.
Flying 02
You're off the mark. To stalk and to feed? You can't imagine a finer pleasure.
Yes, I am. And you're a dear for putting up with this cranky old tressym. I may show my claws now and then, but I hope I never scratch you too deeply.
Heh.
One of my first stops was the House of the Moon, in Waterdeep. It's the largest temple of Selûne in existence.

From: The desk of Blaze Devella Fountainhead, High Constable of the Flaming Fist
To: Honorary Flaming Fist Junior Inspector No. 3 (address provided by dessicated skeleton, name of Withers)

Greetings, and congratulations!
I thought naming you Honorary Junior Investigator would go some small way to thanking you for your help with the Bhaal cult (and should leave me with much less paperwork to do should we need to draft your help again). We've been doing our best to clean up the remaining Bhaalists in this city - starting with the Bhaal Temple. What an absolutely fascinating place - but by gods does it reek. That's the thing books about Bhaal never really get across - the stench.
Found a lot of bad stuff in there. You know they were ritually killing other Bhaalspawn? What a waste. I'm hoping the Society of Brilliance can do something with the relics we uncover - gods know I'd love to visit an exhibit, even if I've seen it all first hand already.
I'd love to catch up and pick your brain about a few cases whenever you're next in the Gate.

Yours faithfully,
Devella Fountainhead.

PS. I'd avoid the Elfsong, if I were you. Investigator Valeria has racked up quite the tab, and has assured the landlord that you promised to settle it next time you're in the city.
I'd like something that feels rich and warm.
Flame-Feeble
I've devoted myself to the hunt. The Sword Coast must be cleansed of its monsters.
No hellbeast is safe from the Blade of Avernus and his infernal powers.
Devotee of Mahkloompah
Restrained but finely-made, this simply elegant suit appeals to a variety of tastes.
Must mean rain.
You're right. Your mere presence alone will leave them awed - just like when I first clapped eyes on you.
Forget I said anything. How have you been?
I wouldn't have missed the chance to see my old friends again.
No time like the present.
Are you sure he'd want to join? I'm not exactly settled anywhere right now. It could be dangerous at times.

I impart what knowledge I can to them, yet in truth they teach me far more. The land we saved is theirs, and they will cherish it, I am sure. Thaniel and Oliver shall never want for friends ever again.
Why, I took time out of my busy schedule to come to your party, didn't I? What greater show of respect could there be?
I admit, I did expect you to be a little bitter about missing out on godhood. But instead you look... happy. And you wear it well.
But of course! Who wouldn't want to hear me speak?
Quite right. And we're delighted every time the catflap of displacement brings you to us.
Thy life was hers for a while. It is now thine again. Live it well.
Let's not sell ourselves short, Halsin. How about a kiss?
Your spells single-handedly rebuilt half the Upper City. Baldur's Gate is your proof.
I returned to Waterdeep a better wizard than I left it. Now, I read, I write, I do a spot of teaching...
Summon a maul.
I still believe in the bow and the blade. But I'm teaching the Fist a new lesson:
I'd ask what you have in mind, but I'm not sure I want to know.
When that is the case, I will gladly come to Avernus to fight by your side once again.
Shatter Visage
You did what you felt you had to do. But I needed you, Lae'zel. I've never needed anyone more.
Souls Sacrificed: 2
For two months we trained the Knights of the Comet. For two more we skewered kith'raki bellies. And for two more yet we travelled through Limbo.
The Blade has been busy - Avernus is my hunting ground now.
Don't I know it. It went so fast, didn't it? One moment we were on the nautiloid, the next we were... here.
Understandable. I am fascinating. And witty. Handsome. A sharp dresser. I smell quite nice...
Obviously they miss us terribly.
Maybe at first. But the person I used to be had a deep empathy that hasn't left me. Let me explain.
Proxy_DOOR_RoomTrigger
Withers didn't say we could bring guests.
That's a good war to fight, though a difficult one to win. There's always more evil out there, my friend.
I could listen to you talk all day, but if you insist.
Milking a cow? Girl, you've got it made. I'd trade with you, if that weren't totally evil.
I would ask if things have been going well, but you seem to be a literal god, so... I'm guessing 'yes'?
I'm afraid the nature of my untimely and tragic demise makes salvaging any vestiges of my mortal existence quite impossible.
*You are an illithid, your body ravaged by ceremorphosis, your mind prey to unfamiliar desires to consume, to devour.*
But we will make the decisions we see fit, the ones that'll restore the city to glory.
I am the Comet. I will not rest until I burn Vlaakith's bones to ash and smash her phylactery to pieces.
Materialise next to your warlock's victim.
It is my sworn duty to protect the Archduke-Elect.
All right, let me see what I have...
I wasn't leaving Lae'zel to face Vlaakith's forces alone.
Are you worried? You are a monstrous vampire spawn, after all.
Have you been... comfortable in the Undercity? Is there anything more I can bring you?
The transition from life to death undoes many a mortal's mind. Thou art confused, but thou willst collect thy thoughts, in time.
I'd rather live in a sewer alone than in a palace with you.
We were unable to send your report at this time. We have stored it and will try to send it again the next time you boot the game.
Hah. How nice to be understood again. I have spent the past months bickering with builders and bankers - all to restore the city exactly as it was.
I've just been trying to live my life, away from Shar's shadow. Isn't always easy, but I'm managing.
Incredible story. I wish I'd been there to see it play out.
Part of me was relieved you left so quickly after the battle. I felt... ashamed. Like I'd lost everything, just as you claimed your victory. I didn't want you to see me like that.
May I have a hug?
*Through sheer, mindless bliss.*
You would be unwise to attempt it, trust me. In any case, the house of my captors is long-extinct.
Cazador Szarr
I know how you feel.
When we first arrived at the city, refugees were swarming the bridge. I understand things have changed.
Connect Account
You look positively perfect - not a tentacle out of place.
Well, I suppose I could share a few harsh lessons I learned in the frontiers.
If only you'd applied those efforts to that thing on your chin...
We'd both love to see you more, Tara. Why don't we have tea when we get home?
... I may be a hater and a gatekeeper, but I'm also god's favourite princess, and the most interesting girl in the world.
Ahh, it smells so good here!
I'm in. We'll set out within the tenday.
You're not done already, surely?
|Gale is not the one I'm speaking to now, am I!|
You proved me a fool. I am forever grateful.
I will never get tired of seeing that face.
Drider
The entangling surface can affect any creatures who move through it.
Reaching
Very little, for now.
Shit - I don't understand it. The blow should have knocked him out, not killed him.
Illithids hunt in the shadows. I can offer diversion, comfort, the pleasure of company...
Hmm, you feel a little more substantial than before. Less camping and scrounging off the land, I take it?
How you'd thrill in the hellhunt, Lae'zel. Slaying fiends is electrifying. The demons I've disintegrated, the devilkin I've bled - the stories I've been itching to tell.
Smell what? The material plane can hardly compete with the aromas of Elysium.
I represent the law, which all must obey. And I order you to leave.
Perhaps Shadowheart and I can give the lecture together.
See No Evil Bear
What's this 'protocol for revivification' you mentioned?
I will join you both, and we will slay the traitorous lich queen.
Letter from Elminster
What's it like, leading the Cloister?

All-consuming. Endless decisions to make, underlings jockeying for your attention, threats from the outside, threats from the inside... there's times I miss when it was just our little group against the odds.
And it looks like life at Shadowheart's side is suiting you...
I fight for Tu'narath, but I do not know it as I know the Gate. Tu'narath is necessary, but the Gate I have felt for.
FINALLY! The Scribe picks an adventurer of substance - of culture! What can I do you for?
I mean to slay every last sarth and kith'rak. And I mean for the Blade of Avernus to join me.
Friend of the Guild, Enemy of the Guild
And? How have our dear friends been without us to guide and protect them?
Present company excluded, of course.
*One day, Halsin returns from a patrol of the borders with a letter held in his jaw. You read it to him, as you scratch behind his ear.*
*Scratch yaps a request you know well. Fetch?*
Not mad, my love. Pragmatic.
I thought you were dead. I haven't heard from you in months...
Baldur's Mouth Gazette
*You feel the vision granted to you by Shar dull. This is not the kind of darkness the Lady cares for.*
Go, have fun. I promise I'll stay out of trouble for one evening.
You can thank my partner for that. Being with them has been a blessing.
Wyll Ravengard Refuses Father's Role: Who Will Lead Next?
Our issue would be perfect...
*You'll fell great beasts and monsters. You'll be hailed as a hero. And you'll always wonder if you've earned the right.*
No thanks - my responsibilities keep me quite busy.
I mean to slay every last sarth and kith'rak. And I mean for Baldur's Gate's grandest duke to join me.
I missed you. You were always good for a laugh on a long trail.
Ha! Oh no, my boy. I haven't felt weak in a long, long time.
We can write our own stories now, and leave our mark on these Realms.
I feel the same, honestly. The woman in the mirror looks unfamiliar sometimes - but she looks happy. And she has plenty of company as well.
Of course! Gond is 'Nebelun' to these gnomes. His true name, at least from their perspective.
Raiding a githyanki stronghold? Hardly behaviour becoming of the god of ambition.
Divine Performance: Endless Spring
Ha! I see it keeps you on a tight leash. Very good.
A pity, to have gone through all that and still not found happiness.
I'm glad there are some limits. You can give up a lot, but lose everything and you lose yourself entirely.
You are more than welcome to join our fight.
I've been doing what I do best - keeping the Sword Coast safe.
Assassin Rogue
*You have no one left to judge you for your sins.*
I've got a nice home in the city, now - a girl named Mindy says I'm her best friend. She's mine, too. Also you. And owlbear. I've got so many best friends, I hardly know who to play with.

Oak Father preserve you - I hope you have a tight hold on the beast. But this shall make for a most stirring tale for the children. I may even have to tone down the details, for fear they get too excited...
Thaniel and Oliver... I never said goodbye. Never saw their land flourish...
Four dogs, eight cats, nine chickens, six pigeons, four sheep, a milk cow named Daphne, a squirrel who's far too clever for her own good, and a wolf cub I found orphaned in some woods.
Sounds foreboding. I presume you're there on business, not pleasure?
But if I can reach those runes, maybe I can steal it back. Take it for myself, even.
I do feel a little bad keeping you all to myself. After all, I get to see you every night.
Subtract [1] from incoming damage.
Karlach is truly lucky to have you in her life - even the Hells themselves cannot dim the love you share.
We already know the true name of Gond: Nebelun.
I accept Larian's <LSTag Type="Hyperlink" Info="ModdingPrivacy">Modding Privacy Policy</LSTag>.
You didn't!
I've got a pair of gauntlets for you - still warm from Raphael's vault.
Pact of the Blade: Sickle
It's every bit as enjoyable as it sounds.
*Zaerith Menyar-Ag-Gith. How well you know the name - the immortal god-king of the githzerai, and ruler of their capital, Shra'kt'lor.*
Father's very well, and back in his element - commanding the Flaming Fist with as brave a heart as ever, and with nary a scolding or lashing.
Nothing but allies, I always told myself. A necessary partnership. But in spite of every strained word, every barbed glance -
Citizens may be hurt if I don't get inside. On my oath, let me in.
I've been happily putting all of this behind me.
You're hardly a pleb, Astarion. You have a palace in the Gate.
Sounds like a trap. This god-king will slay you the moment you show your face.
I can relate, in my own way.
The final, profane ravings of someone who gave in to madness, and worship of a false god.
I recall you have quite a few young wards to care for - nine wagons of them, wasn't it?
Can I have a kiss?
Perhaps you think yourself safe in this projected form, but I assure you, if I wanted you dead, you would be.
I'll have to find somewhere for him to sleep, of course - he'd get stuck in the door of my cottage. Maybe the barn? It's as warm as anywhere, as long as he gets along with the other animals.
We can help, but we need your people to stay out of our way.
We did something incredible. And wherever life takes us - we'll carry the memory of that with us forever.
No, power isn't everything. But it is an awful lot of fun.
Had I known bedtime tales were a possibility, I'd have sought you out at camp.
Well, like it or not, I learned much from my time with you in Faerûn. For instance, that battle is more brutal - and the celebration after more glorious - with a fiery companion at your side.
And Mizora? Is she next on your kill list?
Something singular. Absolute, wouldn't you say?
Zombie
Inappropriate Content
To think I believed godhood was worth losing all this...
The owlbear cub - or well, just owlbear now. I thought you might be willing to look after him.
Aegis of the Absolute: Poison
Alive. But a Harper no more. He's better off out of it.
You can come as soon as you please, so long as the lodgers approve of you.
Nor I, you.
Get some rest here. You've earned it.
Bhaal's Edict
So long as your mistress hasn't bid you to try lure her rivals into a trap or something...
Try to make a Harper sign.
Quite a bit of climbing, then. I have no doubt the archdruid keeps you active - but perhaps you can spare the details for later.
Our gish sent word of the rebellion to Menyar-Ag-Gith through the cosmos. He's agreed to parley.
You might as well ask if the stars will ever snuff out, or Avernus freeze over. A consideration for the far future.
That being said, I haven't completely given up on returning to the sun. If the opportunity presented itself - well, I wouldn't say no...
*You shall soon amass an illithid army to bring slaughter across Faerûn. But now, it is time to unleash Bhaal's adoration upon his beloved city.*
Lead the way, then.
I do
Dead Branch Right
Well, never mind that. By the stars' light and the moon's glow, it's so good to see you, Astarion.
Forgotten Troubadour
It's over. Nothing but dust without Bhaal's vengeance to rouse them.
I might show them how to fend for themselves in the wilds. Few of your kind seem to manage that particular feat.
Crown of Karsus A
Actually, Gale helped me.
*A pocket of psionic energy reaches out from your mind to Orpheus' honour guard. Your plea has been heard - you are welcomed, even in this illithid form.*
Tell him of the tribulations of godhood. The politics, the bureaucracy, the endless prayers to answer...
We could have been conquerors... we could have ruled these Realms as gods.
Dribbles Emoji
Not like. Thou wert her kin. It was written in her heart. Surely thou knowest that?
Ah, my dear friend! It's been an age, has it not? You're looking... erm... well?
I'll be keeping an eye on you.
You have found affection and more on this rock. Stay, and pursue a new life.
It won't be long before he's doing the tearing - if that's what he wishes.
Welcome Spectre
We're adults - the odd regret is normal. Doesn't mean I'm not happy.
You owe them, Astarion. If we can't get their children, at least we can get revenge.
Reluctant Scourge of Avernus
I've settled back into the shadows. It turns out there's a lot more fun to be had there when you don't have a bitter, cruel vampire lord watching over you.
So have I. Sometimes I wish our adventure never ended.
But they deserve happiness. We all do. And I will forever be grateful to have found it with you.
As for roaming... that impulse has dwindled, I must admit. Perhaps because I have found where I am meant to be.
